description_en: Queries all works in a workspace under an organization. You can specify the type of work
description_zh: 查询组织下某个工作空间下的所有作品，可指定作品类型
name: QueryWorksByWorkspace

parameters.help_en:
The type of the work. Valid values:

DATAPRODUCT: BI portal
PAGE: Dashboard
FULLPAGE: full-screen dashboards
REPORT: workbook
parameters.help_zh:
作品类型。取值范围：

DATAPRODUCT：数据门户
PAGE：仪表板
FULLPAGE：全屏仪表板
REPORT：电子表格
parameters.name: works_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the work. Valid values:

0: unpublished
1: published
2: modified but not published
3: unpublished
parameters.help_zh:
作品状态。取值范围：

0：未发布
1：已发布
2：已修改未发布
3：已下线
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
Third-party embedding status. Valid values:

0: The embed service is not enabled.
1: Embed is enabled
parameters.help_zh:
第三方嵌入状态。取值范围：

0：暂未开通嵌入
1：已开通嵌入
parameters.name: third_part_auth_flag

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the returned page.

Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries returned per page.

Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size

Result.description_en: Returns a list of all works in the organization workspace that meet the requested criteria
Result.description_zh: 返回组织工作空间下所有符合请求条件的作品列表

Data.description_en: The details of the list of works

Auth3rdFlag.description_en:
Third-party embedding status. Valid values:

0: The embed service is not enabled.
1: Embed is enabled
Auth3rdFlag.description_zh:
第三方嵌入状态。取值范围：

0：暂未开通嵌入
1：已开通嵌入

Directory.description_en: The directory to which the work belongs

PathId.description_en: The hierarchical structure of the directory ID to which the directory belongs. Separate the hierarchical structure with a /
PathId.description_zh: 所属目录ID的层级结构，以『/』分隔

PathName.description_en: The hierarchical structure of the directory to which the directory belongs. Separate the hierarchical structure with a (/)
PathName.description_zh: 所属目录名称的层级结构，以『/』分隔

GmtCreate.description_en: The timestamp of the creation of the work in milliseconds
GmtCreate.description_zh: 作品创建的毫秒级时间戳

GmtModify.description_en: The timestamp of the modification of the work in milliseconds
GmtModify.description_zh: 作品修改的毫秒级时间戳

OwnerId.description_en: The user ID of the work owner in the Quick BI
OwnerId.example: 作品所属工作空间名称。

OwnerName.description_en: The nickname of the work owner

PublicInvalidTime.description_en: Deadline for the public release of the report

SecurityLevel.description_en:
Security policies for collaborative authorization of works. Valid values:

0: private
12: Authorize specified members
1 or 11: Authorize all workspace members



If you use legacy permissions, the return value is 1.

If you use the new permissions, the return value is 11
SecurityLevel.description_zh:
作品协同授权的安全策略。取值：
0：私密
12：授权指定成员
1或11：授权所有空间成员

若您使用旧版权限，则返回值为1。
若您使用新版权限，则返回值为11

Status.description_en:
Status of dashboards, full-screen dashboards, spreadsheets. The default value of other work types is 1. Valid values:

0: unpublished
1: published
2: modified but not published
3: unpublished
Status.description_zh:
仪表板，全屏仪表板，电子表格的状态。其他作品类型默认为1，取值范围：

0：未发布
1：已发布
2：已修改未发布
3：已下线

WorkType.description_en:
The type of the work. Valid values:

DATAPRODUCT: BI portal
PAGE: Dashboard
FULLPAGE: full-screen dashboards
REPORT: workbook
dashboardOfflineQuery: self-service data retrieval
Analysis: Ad hoc analysis
DATAFORM: form filling
WorkType.description_zh:
作品类型。取值范围：

DATAPRODUCT：数据门户
PAGE：仪表板
FULLPAGE：全屏仪表板
REPORT：电子表格
dashboardOfflineQuery：自助取数
ANALYSIS：即席分析
DATAFORM：表单填报

WorkspaceId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the work belongs

WorkspaceName.description_en: The name of the workspace to which the work belongs
WorkspaceName.description_zh: 作品所属工作空间名称

PageNum.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of rows per page set when the interface is requested
PageSize.description_zh: 请求接口时设置的每页行数

TotalNum.description_en: The total number of rows in the table

TotalPages.description_en: The total number of pages returned

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否请求成功。取值范围：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败
